signedObject: claims object only; detached integrity envelope excluded
propertyOrdering: ECMAScript UTF-16 code-unit ordering as required by RFC 8785
stringSerialization: ECMAScript-compatible JSON string serialization; reject lone surrogates; do not normalize Unicode
numberPolicy: Authorization numbers are safe integers only; reject non-finite, fractional, and unsafe integer values
canonicalClaimsInput: The raw claims JSON value must be byte-for-byte equal to its RFC 8785 JCS serialization
signature: Ed25519 signs the canonical UTF-8 JCS bytes of claims only
inputBindingDigest: SHA-256 over the canonical authenticated dispatch-envelope body, excluding the permit and transport-only metadata; Bridge compares its computed body digest with expectedContext.inputSha256. This digest is not a claim and is not the hash of the claims object.
